items.title: Jayhawks Travel to Stillwater to Take on Cowboys
items.summary: The top passing offense and the top passing defense will square off on Saturday in Stillwater, Oklahoma when Kansas and Oklahoma State match up at 5:15 p.m. on ESPN2. Kansas has won two of the past three meetings with Oklahoma State, topping the Cowboys in Lawrence in 2022 and 2025. The Cowboys lead the all-time series 41-31-3 and 19-14-2 in Stillwater with Kansas last winning there in 2007.
